subject: general
question: When the crank is at the dead centre, what will be the magnitude of bending moment 8 and twisting moment at the crankshaft?

options.text: Both bending moment and the twisting moment are zero in the shaft
Both bending moment and twisting moment on the shaft are maximum
Bending moment on the shaft is maximum and the twisting moment is zero.
Bending moment on the shaft is minimum and the twisting moment is maximum.

solution:
The correct answer is __Bending moment on the shaft is maximum and the twisting moment is zero.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dead Centre__ in a mechanism is a position where the crank and connecting rod align in a straight line.
 
• At the dead centre, the twisting moment on the shaft becomes zero due to no tangential force.
 
• However, the bending moment on the shaft reaches its maximum value due to the vertical load acting on the crank pin.
 
• These conditions are critical for crankshaft design and analysis in engines and mechanisms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Twisting Moment:**

 
 
• It is caused due to the tangential force acting at the crank pin.
 
• Twisting moment transmits torque along the crankshaft.
 
 
 
• **Bending Moment:**
 
 
• It is the result of vertical or horizontal forces acting on the crankshaft.
 
• The bending moment is responsible for structural deformation in the crankshaft.
